name: Tesseract Planner
description: Create and cache a local Tesseract nanobind planner from an exact RobotArtifact. Outputs both the conventional COMPAS planner and an isolated native Robot clone.

inputParameters.name: artifact
inputParameters.description: Exact content-addressed RobotArtifact from Tesseract Robot Artifact.

inputParameters.name: robot_cell
inputParameters.description: Matching COMPAS RobotCell projection. Group joint order is checked against Tesseract.

inputParameters.name: robot_cell_state
inputParameters.description: Optional matching initial RobotCellState retained by the planner.

inputParameters.name: warmup_pipelines
inputParameters.description: Optional exact Task Composer pipeline names to warm during connection. Leave empty for no warmup; cannot be combined with warmup_all.

inputParameters.name: warmup_all
inputParameters.description: Warm every configured Task Composer pipeline during connection. Defaults to false and cannot be combined with warmup_pipelines.

inputParameters.name: reload
inputParameters.description: Force replacement of the cached native client even when the artifact identity is unchanged.

outputParameters.name: planner
outputParameters.description: TesseractPlanner supporting conventional COMPAS calls plus plan_native for lossless native requests/results.

outputParameters.name: native_robot
outputParameters.description: Isolated tesseract_robotics.planning.Robot clone for direct nanobind operations without mutating the cached planner baseline.
